name: British Virgin Islands

findings.local_actor: Government of the Virgin Islands / Royal Virgin Islands Police Force
findings.builder: Cable and Wireless BVI Ltd (Flow BVI)
findings.financier: Caribbean Development Bank and Government of the Virgin Islands capital budget
findings.summary: Government signed a contract worth just over US$411,000 with Cable and Wireless BVI (Flow) to rebuild the territory-wide CCTV surveillance backbone, including dedicated fibre, destroyed by the 2017 hurricanes; CDB and government capital funds paid for it.
findings.analyst_inference: Pole null: no camera or network-equipment vendor is named in any source opened, and under the v0.2 equipment rule the vendor, not the fibre contractor, is the controller. Flow BVI is a Liberty Latin America subsidiary, recorded as builder only. The October 2023 article (police say rollout in final stages) shows progress but names no vendor; both sources are the same outlet, so not corroborated. USD is the territory's currency; value is a floor ('just over').
